app.name: phpusing
app.tagline: Does your PHP site have a headache?
lang.label: Language
popup.unsupported: This page can't be checked. Open your PHP site in a normal tab (http or https).
popup.localOff: Local and private network addresses are not checked by default.
popup.permissionDenied: Chrome access was not allowed, so nothing was checked. Try again when you are ready.
popup.error: Something went wrong. Close the popup and try again.
popup.blocked: Your site's firewall started blocking us, so the check stopped early.
popup.reason.unsupported: This page can't be checked. Open your PHP site in a normal tab (http or https).
popup.reason.notAuthorized: Access for this site is missing. Tick the box and allow access again.
popup.reason.rateLimited: This site was checked twice in the last minute. Wait a moment and try again.
popup.reason.busy: A check is already running in this tab.
popup.reason.failed: The check stopped unexpectedly. Try again.
consent.label: I own this site or have permission to test it.
consent.legal: At most 60 read-only requests, no attacks.
verdict.calm.title: All calm
verdict.calm.body: No critical issues found in what we can see. Keep PHP and plugins updated.
verdict.mild.title: Mild headache
verdict.mild.body: A few things need attention. None look urgent, but fix them this week.
verdict.major.title: Major headache
verdict.major.body: Something serious is exposed. Fix the critical items today.
verdict.unknown.title: Can't tell yet
verdict.unknown.body: We could not see enough to judge. Details below.
